finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I have seen some of the vampires from your clan, and quite a few of my family members have also interacted with them in and around Nevermore, and from that, I noticed something. I hope it will be possible for you to share with me how the Noboru clan managed to become vampires in the first place, as the origin of the transformation isn’t one I recognize,” Fairleigh asked the big question they both knew would be coming.
